subject: Cost-fit decision matrix & host comparisons for NimblePay pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kade <samira.k@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Cost-fit decision matrix & next steps (post-demo recap)

Hi Samira — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick written recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and I can loop in pricing/procurement next.

Call highlights (condensed):
- Monthly volume band: target 3–12M tokens/month in initial pilot; long-term could scale to 30–50M/mo depending on usage.
- Current blended cost: you mentioned ~32 USD per 1M tokens on your incumbent host (includes embeddings + generation).
- Budget target: flexible, but primary ask was to get to ~10–15 USD per 1M tokens for the pilot with demonstrable latency and quality parity.
- Key non-price requirements: P99 latency < 300ms for short prompts, SOC2 evidence, and audit logs for data retention.

Benchmark guidance we discussed (rough, for decision framing):
- OpenAI-hosted baseline: ~14 USD/1M tokens (public-host equivalent offering we compared in the call).
- Anthropic-hosted baseline: ~20 USD/1M tokens.
- Typical open-model hosts (quantized VM/replicate-style): 9–13 USD/1M depending on quantization and caching.

Early Redwood positioning for NimblePay (ballpark):
- Hosted pilot price: 12 USD / 1M tokens (no commit) — optimized for quick ramp and full managed stack.
- Dedicated/reserved profile: 8 USD / 1M tokens (12mo commit + throughput guarantee) — for predictable unit economics.
- Add-ons: premium SLA + private control plane add ~2–3 USD/1M depending on retention and KMS needs.

Attached: nimblepay-decision-matrix.xlsx (cost/latency/SLA weightings) and redwood-cost-scenarios.csv with tiered $/1M math. I populated a basic decision matrix (cost weight 50%, latency 30%, SLA/compliance 20%) based on our conversation — please take a look.

Asks / next steps:
1) Samira: confirm whether procurement prefers an MSA-first or SOW-first flow and the contact for legal/procurement so we can prep draft.
2) Ben/Laure: can you prepare a pilot pricing sheet that shows both hosted and dedicated columns plus a fast-fail clause for quality? Ben — want a target-ready slide by Tue.
3) Samira: confirm a 1-week window for a short pilot (5M tokens) starting early Dec if that still works.

If you’re good with the matrix approach I’ll kick off a short internal run to model the 5M pilot and a 12mo committed option (we can optimize using caching/quantization knobs in Redwood Optimize).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Samira Kade <samira.k@nimblepay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, NimblePay Procurement <procurement@nimblepay.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cost-fit decision matrix & next steps (post-demo recap)

Marcus — thanks for the tidy recap and the spreadsheet. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Budget flexibility: we can stretch to ~18 USD/1M if Redwood can show consistent latency and - importantly - inference quality matching our current model outputs during the pilot.
- Pilot size: 5M/month for 6 weeks is ideal for us to evaluate edge cases; if quality is good, we'll move to a 3mo paid pilot with 12mo review.
- Procurement preference: SOW first for pilots, then MSA for production. Point of contact is procurement@nimblepay.com (CC’d).

Please include a line item for a 2-week rolling data retention sample for audit. Also, Samir (our infra lead) asked whether quantized model variants are included in the hosted price or treated as a different SKU.

Happy to move forward quickly — can you share the pilot SOW template and a simple price table (hosted vs reserved) by Tue?

— Samira
VP, Product
NimblePay
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kade <samira.k@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, NimblePay Procurement <procurement@nimblepay.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cost-fit decision matrix & next steps (post-demo recap)

Samira — thanks and great to hear about the flexibility. I’ll own the commercial proposal. Quick responses inline: 

- Quantized variants: included in the hosted pilot price (12 USD/1M) for evaluation — we won’t charge a separate SKU during pilot. For production we show a breakdown (quantized vs full-precision) so you can choose.
- Retention/ audit sample: included in the pilot SOW — Laura will scope the log retention and audit export.

Planned deliverables (timeline):
- Tue EOD: pilot SOW + simple pricing table (hosted vs reserved + committable discount column).
- Wed: internal decision matrix review with Marcus/Laura to set the final numeric targets and fallback rules.
- Thu: send commercial proposal + one-pager and link to HubSpot deal.

Action items for Redwood (owners):
- Ben: draft proposal + HubSpot update (Deal HP-4382).
- Marcus: finalize decision matrix weights + run cost scenarios using 5M pilot baseline.
- Laura: scope SOW retention + responsibilities for pilot support.

Samira — is procurement available for a 30-min call Wed 11:00 AM PT so we can walk the SOW? If that works I’ll send an invite.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kade <samira.k@nimblepay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cost-fit decision matrix & next steps (post-demo recap)

All — I’ll own the SOW and pilot support once Ben hands over the commercial. I’ll draft the 2-week audit data extract clause, plus an SLA appendix for P99 latency targets.

Deliverables I’ll share:
- Pilot SOW draft (template attached): pilot-sow-template.docx
- Retention & audit excerpt for legal review
- War-room contact list for the pilot (owner, escalation, weekly check-in cadence)

I'll sync with Marcus this afternoon to make sure the latency/availability targets in the decision matrix are measurable and instrumented in the Redwood Console (tracing + per-route dashboards).

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
